items: KATSINA STATE (PSI 9.3): Governor Radda Launches SEMSAS Emergency Ambulances and Awards N1m DRATESS Grants
ONDO STATE (PSI 8.9): Governor Aiyedatiwa Unveils 203-Ward Agric Strategy, Raises Budget to N769.3bn, and Swears In Cabinet
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.8): Governor Otti Launches UK-FCDO SPRIRET Digital Program and Refutes False Utterances
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 8.6): Cross River Graduates 2,400 CIVTECH Civil Servants, Flags Off Disability Survey, and Desilts UniCROSS Drainage
NIGER STATE (PSI 8.5): Governor Umaru Bago Showcases Agribusiness Value Chain at FirstBank Expo in Lagos
TARABA STATE (PSI 8.4): Governor Kefas Inspects Permanent Site for 6 Brigade Nigerian Army in Wukari
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.3): Governor Mutfwang Named Leadership Governor of the Year 2026 and Reaffirms ECWA Partnership
ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.2): Governor Mbah Inspects Owo-Ebia Ikem Road, Resolves Ogbete Terminal Policy, and Supports Returnees
OSUN STATE (PSI 8.1): Osun Security Council Approves Joint Security Task Force Following Terror Alerts
EDO STATE (PSI 8.0): Edo Opens UAE Investment Talks on Agribusiness and Distributes 1,200 Fertilizer Bags
LAGOS STATE (PSI 7.8): Lagos Begins 2027 PHC Planning, Holds SDG Legal Forum, and Schedules Physical Planning Sessions
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 7.6): Deputy Governor Farauta Keynotes CON Conference and Commissions ADSU International Centre
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.5): Gombe Advocates Global Digital Identity Framework and Engages Power Stakeholders
BORNO STATE (PSI 7.4): Governor Zulum Arrives in Canada for Tech, Education, and Agricultural Partnerships
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 7.2): Zamfara Civil Service Begins PSIN Refresher Course for Aspiring Permanent Secretaries
KADUNA STATE (PSI 7.0): Governor Uba Sani Meets Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele on Economic Reforms and Financial Inclusion
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 6.8): Akwa Ibom Commissions Ikot Ekpene Model School and Receives GWR Holder Hilda Baci
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 6.5): Jigawa Government Constructs 4km Dual-Carriage Road and Urban Upgrades in Aujara
KWARA STATE (PSI 6.2): Governor AbdulRazaq Appoints Ex-Rep Mashood Mustapha as 2027 Ameerul Hajj
DELTA STATE (PSI 6.0): Delta State Government Completes Udu Harbour Market and Ongoing Drainage Works
OYO STATE (PSI 5.8): Oyo State Progresses Construction of Special Agro-Industrial Processing Zone in Ijaiye
YOBE STATE (PSI 5.5): Governor Mai Mala Buni Leads Presidential Condolence Delegation to Zamfara

KATSINA (PSI 9.3): Commissioned upgraded Charanchi General Hospital, deployed 238 rural tricycle ambulances and 15 Advanced Life Support Ambulances under SEMSAS across 268 PHCs, and presented N1m take-off grants to 361 Songhai agribusiness graduates.

ONDO (PSI 8.9): Unveiled 203-Ward Agricultural Export Programme and EUDR compliance committee at FirstBank Expo; swore in new commissioner, advisers, and board chairmen; and raised 2026 budget to N769.38bn for 90km LGA road construction.

ABIA (PSI 8.8): Launched SPRIRET digital framework with UK FCDO and British High Commission to reform tech regulations, leveraging N2bn startup fund and Dig-Once policy, while firmly refuting false clannish statements credited to Chief Charles Ogbonna.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.6): Graduated 2,400 civil servants from CIVTECH digital skills training, commenced statewide Disability Survey for inclusive planning, sponsored 12 LGA auditors to ANAN conference, and mobilized joint CR-SEMA/NEMA flood desilting at UniCROSS.

NIGER (PSI 8.5): Governor Mohammed Umaru Bago showcased Niger State's agricultural processing footprints, massive land assets, and value chain investment opportunities at the 5th FirstBank Agric & Export Expo in Lagos.

TARABA (PSI 8.4): Inspected designated permanent site for construction of 6 Brigade Nigerian Army in Wukari alongside GOC 10 Division and Aku Uka of Wukari to establish permanent military infrastructure and ease security tensions.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.3): Received LEADERSHIP Newspaper Governor of the Year 2026 award notification for urban renewal and peacebuilding, while hosting ECWA District Church Councils in Jos to deepen faith-based agricultural fertilizer support.

ENUGU (PSI 8.2): Inspected ongoing 35km Owo-Ebia Ikem Road; resolved Ogbete market commercial transit disputes with driver unions; and provided N77m seed capital to 112 returnees affected by South Africa xenophobic attacks.

OSUN (PSI 8.1): Approved establishment and logistical funding for a Joint Security Taskforce (JTF) on 24-hour red alert following security alerts to protect schools, places of worship, and public infrastructure.
EDO (PSI 8.0): Engaged UAE Ambassador in Abuja for December Agric Investment Summit, and distributed 1,200 fertilizer bags, 70 chemical cartons, and 650 sprayers to central district farmers in Irrua.

LAGOS (PSI 7.8): Commenced 2027 Primary Healthcare AOP planning under national SWAp framework, held legal stakeholders forum on SDG implementation, and announced zonal physical planning sessions on the EPPPS digital permit system.

ADAMAWA (PSI 7.6): Deputy Governor Prof. Kaletapwa Farauta advocated AI-driven curriculum reforms at 37th CON Conference at Adamawa State University, Mubi, after commissioning the institution's International Conference Centre.

GOMBE (PSI 7.5): Advocated global digital identity standards during NIMC National Day visit, while GOSERC engaged commercial millers and stakeholders to decentralize state electricity market regulation.

BORNO (PSI 7.4): Governor Babagana Umara Zulum arrived in Canada to engage leading universities, tech firms, and research institutes for scholarships, innovation hubs in Maiduguri, and livestock technology transfer.

ZAMFARA (PSI 7.2): Flagged off the second edition of the Pre-Examination Refresher Course with PSIN in Gusau for Directors aspiring to Permanent Secretary positions to enhance public service rules and procurement capacity.

KADUNA (PSI 7.0): Governor Uba Sani held bilateral discussions with Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele in Abuja on rural economic expansion, financial inclusion initiatives, and poverty reduction under the Renewed Hope Agenda.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 6.8): Commissioned a fully equipped Model Primary School in Ikot Ekpene LGA and received Guinness World Record holder Hilda Baci at Government House, Uyo.
JIGAWA (PSI 6.5): Executed 4 kilometres of dual-carriage and single-lane roads in Aujara town, complete with drainage networks, greenery, and landscaping to improve connectivity and flood control.
KWARA (PSI 6.2): Approved the appointment of Alhaji Mashood Mustapha, Wakili of Ilorin Emirate, as Ameerul Hajj to lead Kwara's contingent for the 2027 Muslim pilgrimage in Saudi Arabia.
DELTA (PSI 6.0): Completed construction of Udu Harbour Market alongside surrounding access roads and drainage infrastructure to eliminate commercial flooding for local traders.
OYO (PSI 5.8): Advanced civil construction works at the 3,000-hectare Special Agro-Industrial Processing Zone (SAPZ) at the Ijaiye Agribusiness Industrial Hub to boost non-oil export processing.

YOBE (PSI 5.5): Governor Mai Mala Buni led a presidential delegation to Talata Mafara, Zamfara State, to deliver President Bola Tinubu's condolences to Senator Abdulazeez Yari over his aunt's passing.
